shortDescription: NetApp E-Series manage array host groups

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API. Example https://prod-1.wahoo.acme.com/devmgr/v2

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: hosts
options.description: List of host names/labels to add to the group

options.name: id
options.description: Host reference identifier for the host group to manage. This option is mutually exclusive with I(name).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the host group to manage This option is mutually exclusive with I(id).

options.name: new_name
options.description: Specify this when you need to update the name of a host group

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified host group should exist or not.
